question_text: Complete the following text with right forms of the verbs given in the box.
stimulus: 0.510=5 cause suffer to be drive solve to be obey occur carry Traffic jam (a) ⎯ a common affair in the big cities of our country. This problem (b) ⎯ the ultimate consequence of rapid growth of population and the number of vehicles. Most often this problem (c) ⎯ in the congested areas where the road are very narrow. Overtaking tendency also (d) ⎯ traffic jam. Some drivers (e) ⎯ the traffic rules. They (f) ⎯ the vehicles carelessly. Traffic jam (g) ⎯ great sufferings to the ambulances (h) ⎯ patients. Offices goers and school going children also (i) ⎯ a lot due to traffic jam. However, this problem (j) ⎯ to an extent by imposing traffic rules strictly.
